description: Read only plus 'Only allow writes under /papers' is accepted. The agent is then logged in with 'Scopes: read' and 'Writes limited to: /papers', and the done card does not mention the folder. The form should disable or explain the folder field when Read only is ticked.
expected: Folder field disabled or ignored with a visible note when Read only is on.
actual: CLI prints 'Scopes: read' and 'Writes limited to: /papers'.
suggested_fix: Disable the folder field when Read only is checked.

description: The Drive select shows two drives with the same name ('luis-claude' and 'luis-claude (Dennisons-Mac-Studio.local)'); there is no size, id or created date to tell them apart, so a user could hand the wrong drive's key.
expected: Distinguishing detail such as the short drive id.
suggested_fix: Append short id or created date.

description: The entry link 'Use one of my drives instead (needs its recovery file)' is hidden inside the collapsed Details panel as small underlined text, and says 'recovery file' although a pasted key or an adcred1 bundle also works.
expected: Visible choice for the existing-drive path; wording matching what is accepted.
suggested_fix: Reword to 'Use one of my existing drives'.

description: In the existing-drive form, 'Or choose a file' is in the right column under the folder field while the Drive key is in the left column, so the 'Or' alternative is not next to what it replaces; the Drive key placeholder is clipped ('Paste the drive key or a').
expected: Key and file chooser adjacent; placeholder readable.
suggested_fix: Put key and file in one row, folder below.

description: Clicking Approve with an empty form shows only the verification code error; the empty key error appears only after the code is fixed, so a user needs two round trips.
expected: Show all missing-field errors at once.

description: At 390 px the Approve button is a sticky bar that covers the bottom of the form hint text.
actual: Hint 'A drive with no files or trace inbox has nothing to check it...' is cut by the bar.
suggested_fix: Add bottom padding equal to the bar height.
